notes.zh: 桌面网格模型新增相机动画时间轴：关键帧、平滑过渡、预览、JSON 保存与 MP4 / WebM / PNG 序列导出。本版仍提供完整 APK 和兼容热更新；手机网页与 App 暂未启用时间轴。
notes.en: Desktop Mesh Viewer adds camera keyframes, smooth transitions, playback, JSON backups and MP4 / WebM / PNG sequence export. Includes a complete APK and compatible web update; the timeline is not yet enabled on mobile web or App.
